  end
  subgraph SNAP["Tests snapshot"]
    SB["tests/snapshot/hcl/basic.hcl"]
    SN["tests/snapshot/hcl/basic.hcl.snap"]

  MAIN --> CB
  HCL --> CB
  TF --> CB
  CT --> GH
  CT --> GT
  GH --> SB
  SB --> SN
